extracted.name: Simple Garbanzos
extracted.description: Garbanzo beans and peas are coated with a seasoned olive oil dressing and served chilled.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15.5 ounce) can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
instruction_lines: Combine garbanzo beans, onion, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper in a bowl; stir in olive oil and adjust seasonings. Stir in peas. Cover; marinate in the refrigerator at least 1 hour.
